description: Screen up to 25 blockchain addresses in a single call. Returns a per-address verdict (clear | caution | risky | invalid), risk score, blocked flag, and top signal, plus a summary count, sorted risky-first. Cheaper per address than screening one at a time. EVM (0x…) and Tron (T…). PAID via x402: moves REAL money and requires OCEANALT_PAYER_KEY. Costs $0.10 in real USDC settled on Base mainnet (eip155:8453) — confirm the live network/price at https://oceanalt.com/api/x402 and use a dedicated low-balance payer wallet.

addresses.description: Addresses to screen (max 25), each 0x… (EVM) or T… (Tron). Duplicates and blank entries are ignored.

name: batch_screen
title: Batch-screen up to 25 addresses (paid, x402 $0.10)
